alias_meaning: Owner-selected current READY throughput reference, not proof of a global throughput optimum.

scheduling.adapter_scope: Same exact task adapter; multiple test outputs may share the resident pool; never mix different task adapters.
scheduling.root_grouping: Exact tokenizer root length; dynamically re-evaluate READY position and cache compatibility before every physical forward.
scheduling.cache: ChunkedDynamicCache with independent ownership and valid-length rollback
scheduling.adapter_mode: Unmerged foundation plus fresh task adapter; do not silently replace with merged weights.
scheduling.lane_count_cap: Both resident capacity and physical ceiling are capped by the available same-adapter cells.
scheduling.live_kv_protection: Position >2048 caps B8; >2653 caps B4; >6493 caps B2. For a starting ceiling above eight, position >2048 or allocated memory >=20 GiB permanently soft-disables B16 for that task attempt.
scheduling.oom_recovery: Preserve completed outputs and failure receipt; discard only uncommitted task work; retry widths 8,4,2,1 after the initial profile. This registration grants no additional execution authorization.

scientific_contract_unchanged.time_accounting: Existing V2 active-time amendment: charge each participating cell the full synchronized forward duration, not batch-divided time; exclude queue waiting.
scientific_contract_unchanged.targets: Remain inaccessible until required raw candidate and trace freezes.

verification_snapshot.hardware_scope: Current RTX 3090 24 GB RunPod runtime; not a universal GPU capacity policy.

root_audit.method: CPU-only actual native tokenizer and production prompt constructor on all 89 outputs and eight views; no model loading or target access.

verification_snapshot.canary_scope: Isolated R128: two short outputs sharing B16 and one long output at B2; not adopted as formal R1024 results.
verification_snapshot.oom_claim: NO_OOM_OBSERVED_IN_AUDITED_RESTORED_RUN_TO_DATE; zero OOM for the entire unfinished run is not yet established.

reuse_rule: Reuse this exact implementation/config reference, not a copied engine. Runtime task identity always derives from the actual mounted challenge. Future hardware or policy changes require a separately identified profile; never overwrite this reference.
